summary: Customer feedback form testing found one unresolved acceptance defect. Approved non-browser checks passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`; `npx.cmd prisma validate`; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; `npm.cmd run lint`; and `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-delivery-behavior.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\dashboard\dashboard-authenticated-shell-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\feedback\feedback-request-batch-upload-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\feedback\customer-feedback-form-source.test.mjs` with 27/27 passing. Source review confirmed public `/feedback/[identifier]`, identifier shape validation, 30-day expiry, product/purchase display, 1-10 rating, 200-character required message validation, conditional update of the existing Feedback row, and read-only repeat visit display. However, Prisma lookup/update exceptions are not handled with a safe customer-facing failure state. Browser verification, Playwright/e2e tests, app server startup, production build, deployment, publishing, and real email/customer contact were not run per task constraints and are not claimed as passed.

defects.description: Database lookup/update failures are not converted to safe customer-facing failure states. Requirements FCF-LINK-011 and FCF-UPDATE-054 expect database lookup/update failures to fail safely without exposing raw server failures or claiming success. In `src/features/feedback-submission/service.ts`, `resolvePublicFeedback` awaits `prisma.feedback.findUnique` at lines 56-59 without error handling, and `submitPublicFeedback` awaits `prisma.feedback.updateMany` at lines 111-121 without error handling. If Prisma throws during page resolution or submission, the public route/server action will throw instead of returning a safe unavailable/error state.
